name: RecordPerson
description: One person — team member, contact or author: name, role, contact details, portrait and a bio, plus their own profile page at /person/<slug> with a free content body.
when_to_use: A team section where each person has a profile worth linking to, or a named contact reused across pages. When the client only wants a flat grid of faces with no detail pages, the Team content element is simpler.
capabilities: role, email, phone and mobile for contact blocks
portrait used as both the card image and the page header image
links collection for profiles (LinkedIn, Xing, a personal site)
content_elements: the profile body — any active Content Block

ai.prompt_summary: Person record (tx_factorycore_record_person, type slug 'person'): title (required — the full display name, e.g. 'Dr. Anna Weber'), slug (required, auto from title), role (job title), excerpt (one line for the card), email, phone, mobile, hero_image (the portrait — array of one file), bio (longer text for the profile), links[] ({label, url}), content_elements (the body).
ai.content_guidelines: `title` is the person's name, never a role. Put the role in `role`. Never invent contact details or a biography for a real person — leave the field empty and ask.

field_hints.title: The display name. Roles belong in `role`, or the team grid shows the job title where the name should be.
field_hints.hero_image: The portrait, named hero_image because every card and page header reads that key.
field_hints.links: A collection of {label, url}; keep labels short ('LinkedIn').
